''See also: [[Consultant Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Consultants]] are a highly efficient and secretive [[Guild]] known for their vast information networks and ability to provide specialized advice or services. While they are widely recognized as the most loyal servants of The Empire{{!}}the Empire—maintaining a two-thousand-year history of absolute dedication to the Emperor—their primary motivation is their commitment to fulfilling contracts for paying clients. They are known to be able to influence business outcomes, win battles through strategic intervention, and provide expert security redesigns. [[The Guild]] operates with extreme discretion, often prioritizing the perception of omniscience to unnerve clients and competitors. Their members undergo rigorous training; for example, Shepherds specialize in infiltration, observation, and memory retention to build the [[Guild]]'s legendary reputation for accuracy. Although they are not professional assassins, they are capable of sabotage and lethal force when required by their duties or to protect a client. The organization is structured with various roles and has recently moved toward appointing a singular Blackwatch Guild Head{{!}}Guild Head, though it was previously led by a High [[Council]]. While they are considered an unstoppable force in information manipulation and sabotage, they are noted to be less effective in direct, head-on combat.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[The Consultant]] is a blond individual belonging to a group known for utilizing hides and guerrilla tactics during attacks. This entity possesses the ability to throw blades to intercept targets. While Imperial Steward Calder Marten{{!}}Calder Marten eventually used the power of the Emperor's crown to drive the group away, a Consultant was expected to reveal a secret entrance to him. Notably, [[Calder]]'s mother serves as the right hand to the Consultant.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Consultants]] are capable of throwing blades to stop targets.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c12">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[The Consultant]]'s right hand is [[Calder]]'s mother.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c20">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 20</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|A [[Consultant]] is expected to show [[Calder]] a secret entrance.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c23">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Imperial Steward Calder Marten{{!}}Calder Marten drove [[Consultants]] away with the power of the Emperor's crown.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c23" />}}</li>

</ul></div>

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The [[Consultants]] are a diverse group of professionals, including [[Kerian]], who specialize in equipment maintenance. While they treat the words of their temporary clients as absolute law, their ultimate loyalty lies in serving and defending the Emperor. These individuals can be seen flying across craters in black clothing, and they often remain close to the Emperor's side. During her training for this profession, [[Meia]] killed a Consultant by crushing its skull. The role is highly sought after, as seen with [[Shera]], who aims to become one and has been aided by a yellow-haired Consultant friend during her time on [[Nakothi’s island]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">12</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Consultants]] are a group that [[Kerian]] belongs to.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c1">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 1</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Consultants]] provide maintenance for equipment.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c3">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 3</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|There are many different kinds of [[Consultants]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c3" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|A [[Consultant]] never misses her appointments.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c3" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Consultants]] treat their temporary clients as if their word is [[Imperial law]], but ultimately serve the Emperor.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c5">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Consultants]] can be black-clad and fly across craters.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c11">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Meia]] is undergoing [[Consultant]] training.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c15">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Meia]] killed a [[Consultant]] by crushing its skull.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c15" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Consultant]] is a role or profession [[Shera]] aims to achieve.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c19">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Consultants]] serve The Empire{{!}}the Empire.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c26">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 26</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Consultants]] are often around the Emperor, either working for him or defending him.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c27">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 27</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Shera]] has a yellow-haired [[Consultant]] friend who defended her on [[Nakothi’s island]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c27" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[The Consultant]] is a specialized group composed of the [[Gardeners]] and Shepherds orders. As members of a formal [[Guild]], these individuals serve as guides for others navigating through the mist. While they frequently operate in teams, [[Meia]] personally views her specific role as a fulfillment of her duty as a Consultant.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Consultants]] are individuals who guide others through the mist.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Consultants]] often work in teams.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c15">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“And her right hand is your mother,” the Consultant finished.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c20" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“There are many different kinds of Consultants,” Kerian replied.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c3" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“We treat our temporary clients as if their word is Imperial law, but we ultimately have one client whose<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c5" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“To serve our clients as we serve the Empire.” It was an easy question to answer; any Consultant would have answered the same.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c26" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|“Consultants follow orders. From the Architects, from the clients, from the Emperor…above all else, we follow orders.”<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c2" />}}
